reference_sql:
WITH numbered AS (
  -- one row per session, with its channel and its place among the visitor's sessions
  SELECT s.session_start,
         CASE WHEN s.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN ch.channel_name
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
              ELSE 'direct' END AS channel,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.visitor_id ORDER BY s.session_start, s.session_id) AS visit_no
  FROM sessions AS s
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.utm_campaign = s.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
)
-- one row per channel
SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS sessions,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visit_no = 1) AS first_visits,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visit_no = 1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS first_visit_pct
FROM numbered
WHERE session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY first_visit_pct DESC, channel

WITH channel_sessions AS (
  -- one row per session, with its channel
  SELECT s.session_id, s.visitor_id, s.session_start,
         CASE WHEN s.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL THEN ch.channel_name
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
              WHEN s.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
              ELSE 'direct' END AS channel
  FROM sessions AS s
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.utm_campaign = s.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
),
numbered AS (
  -- one row per session, with its place among all of its visitor's sessions
  SELECT channel, session_start,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY session_start ASC, session_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM channel_sessions
),
in_period AS (
  -- one row per session from July to October 2025, with a first-visit flag
  SELECT channel, CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_first
  FROM numbered
  WHERE session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'
)
-- one row per channel
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SUM(is_first) AS first_visits,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_first) / COUNT(*), 1) AS first_visit_pct
FROM in_period
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY first_visit_pct DESC, channel ASC

WITH numbered AS (
  -- one row per session, with its channel and its place among the visitor's sessions
  SELECT s.session_start,
         COALESCE(ch.channel_name,
                  CASE WHEN s.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic'
                       WHEN s.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral'
                       ELSE 'direct' END) AS channel,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.visitor_id ORDER BY s.session_start, s.session_id) AS visit_no
  FROM sessions AS s
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c ON c.utm_campaign = s.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = c.channel_id
),
per_channel AS (
  -- one row per channel: its sessions in the period and how many were first visits
  SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(CASE WHEN visit_no = 1 THEN 1 END) AS first_visits
  FROM numbered
  WHERE CAST(session_start AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT channel, sessions, first_visits, ROUND(100.0 * first_visits / sessions, 1) AS first_visit_pct
FROM per_channel
ORDER BY first_visit_pct DESC, channel

solver.query:
WITH s AS (SELECT session_id, visitor_id, session_start, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY visitor_id ORDER BY session_start, session_id) AS rn FROM sessions),
p AS (SELECT * FROM s WHERE session_start >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND session_start < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-11-01 00:00:00+00'),
c AS (SELECT p.rn, COALESCE(ch.channel_name, CASE WHEN p.utm_medium = 'organic' THEN 'organic' WHEN p.utm_medium = 'referral' THEN 'referral' ELSE 'direct' END) AS channel
  FROM p LEFT JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.utm_campaign = p.utm_campaign LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = ca.channel_id)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS first_visits, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1)/COUNT(*),1) AS first_visit_pct
FROM c GROUP BY channel ORDER BY first_visit_pct DESC, channel;
